title: C04 RSC/Client boundary refactor

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The refactor pushes 'use client' down to the smallest interactive island and records the measured client-bundle delta (before vs after) in bundle-delta.md (QA non-blocker: client bundle size delta for the RSC boundary challenge is documented; QA: code-splitting separates client and server chunks).

All props crossing the server→client boundary are serializable, and the solution demonstrates the Server-Components-as-children composition pattern (a Client Component receiving a Server Component via children rather than importing it).

_lib/server-secret.ts uses the `server-only` guard and is never reachable from a Client Component, so no secret string appears in any client chunk after build (QA: reference solutions do not expose server-only env vars in the client bundle).

The seller live-metrics widget is deliberately CSR (its content is absent from initial SSR HTML, appears only after JS), and the account page is SSR-dynamic and imports the frozen lib/auth getSession to read the current user (QA: the deliberate CSR widget is client-rendered and not present in initial SSR HTML).

The c04 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; the account page imports auth via the frozen interface only and does not edit lib/auth.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
